Ntotal number of jobs.

n_{f}total number of heterogeneous factories.
Fthe ensemble of heterogeneous factories and F = \{1, \dots, n_{f}\}.
m_{f}the number of machines of factory F_{f}.
M_{f}the set of machines of factory F_{f} and M_{f} = \{1, \dots, m_{f}\}.
M^{n}the vector of the number of machines for each factory.
n_{i}the number of operations of the job I_{i}.
J_{i}the set of operations of job I_{i} and J_{i} = \{1, \dots, n_{i}\}.
J^{n}the vector of the number of operations for each job.
O_{i,j}the j-th operation of I_{i}.
M_{i,j,f}the set of available machines of O_{i,j} in F_{f}.
M_{i,j,f}^{n}the number of available machines of O_{i,j} in F_{f}.
T_{i,j,f,m}the processing time of the operation O_{i,j} on the m-th machine in F_{f}.
x_{i,j,f,m}x_{i,j,f,m} is a bool decision variable. If O_{i,j} is processed on the m-th machine in F_{f}, x_{i,j,f,m} = 1; otherwise, x_{i,j,f,m} = 0.
\varphi_{i,j,f,m}\varphi_{i,j,f,m} is a bool decision variable. If the m-th machine in F_{f} is included in M_{i,j,f}, \varphi_{i,j,f,m} = 1; otherwise, \varphi_{i,j,f,m} = 0.
u_{i,j,f,m,p}u_{i,j,f,m,p} is a bool decision variable. If O_{i,j} is processed at the p-th position on the m-th machine in F_{f}, u_{i,j,f,m,p} = 1; otherwise, u_{i,j,f,m,p} = 0.
v_{i,f}v_{i,f} is a bool decision variable. If I_{i} is assigned to F_{f}, v_{i,f} = 1; otherwise, v_{i,f} = 0.
W_{I}the idle power of all machines.
W_{P}the process power of all machines.
P_{f,m}the number of positions of the m-th machine in F_{f}. Each position corresponds to an operation.
ST_{i,j,f}the start processing time of O_{i,j} in F_{f}.
FT_{i,j,f}the finish processing time of O_{i,j} in F_{f}.
SP_{f,m,p}the start processing time of the p-th position on the m-th machine in F_{f}.
FP_{f,m,p}the finish processing time of the p-th position on the m-th machine in F_{f}.
